Adobe Activation Tool Online (推荐)

Activation Guide/How to Use:

  1. It is strongly recommended that you register a new Adobe account (with a temporary email address) and then start the following activation steps

  3. To download Adobe product software, you can choose one of the following two ways:
    • Activate with the activation tool of version 1.2.5Adobe Creative CloudAfter that, you can directly install the corresponding software (推荐)
    • useAdobe DownloaderDownload and install the corresponding software
  4. Open the activation tool and select the corresponding software and click to start activation, you need to select the corresponding APP instead of the folder. Example:/Applications/Adobe Lightroom Classic/Adobe Lightroom Classic.app

1.2.31.2.5

Activation tool activationAdobe Creative CloudSteps:

1. It is recommended to use it firstAdobe Creative CloudCleaning toolsUninstallAdobe Creative CloudAfter reinstalling it for activation

ACC IntelACC ARMAdobe Creative CloudCleaning tools

2.系统偏好设置/隐私与安全性/App 管理insideAdobe Activation ToolThe switch is turned on.This step is very important and cannot be ignored

4. Reopen after successful activationAdobe Creative CloudYou can see the install button, if it is turned on and the free trial is also displayed, you can restart the device

  • Preferences->General-> automatically keeps Creative Cloud up to date

Problems with activation?

  • Successful activation or pop-up trial window? Please re-register your Adobe account and sign in
  • If the activation is successful, if you encounter that some software shows that there is no install button for the trial, please register your Adobe account again and log in
  • Check the proxy tool/hosts file to see if there is a blocking adobe domain, please unblock it
  • In the software interface, you can see the user avatar or the help menu, and you can see the login information being activated
